definition: VIGRA is the abbreviation for "Vision with Generic Algorithms".
details: It is a free open-source computer vision library which focuses on customizable algorithms and data structures. VIGRA component can be easily adapted to specific needs of target application without compromising execution speed, by using template techniques similar to those in the C++ Standard Template Library.

explainer.lead: VIGRA stands for Vision with Generic Algorithms, a free open-source computer vision library focused on customizable algorithms and data structures. It matters because components can be adapted to a target application without sacrificing execution speed.

tiers.eli5: It's a toolbox where each tool can be reshaped to fit your hand without making it slower to use.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers customize VIGRA components to specific application needs using C++ template techniques similar to the Standard Template Library. A common pitfall is that heavy template use raises compile times and makes error messages hard to read.
tiers.paperLevel: A free open-source computer vision library emphasizing customizable algorithms and data structures; adaptation is achieved through template techniques similar to the C++ Standard Template Library, preserving execution speed.

explainer.example: A team specializes a VIGRA image-processing component to its own pixel type via templates and keeps the same runtime speed.
